title: Integrating-factor monotonicity for one fixed radial cutoff (Simon Ch. 4, 3.4-3.5 and 4.3-4.4)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, E := R^{n+l}, mu a measure on E, H : E -> E, y in E, phi : R -> R, I, a : R -> R and T, S, M, beta real numbers. Write r(x) := |x - y|, B_S(y) for the closed ball, phi' := deriv phi and L(t) := integral_E phi(r(x)/t) ((x - y).H(x)) dmu(x). Assume: T > 0; beta < 1; mu(B_S(y)) < infinity; H is mu-integrable on B_S(y); phi is C^1 and nonincreasing; phi(t) = 0 for all t >= T; (R) for every rho > 0 with T rho < S, integral_E [n phi(r/rho) + (r/rho) phi'(r/rho)] dmu <= - integral_E phi(r/rho) (x - y).H dmu; I(t) = integral_E phi(r(x)/t) dmu(x) for every real t; a(t) = L(t)/t^(n+1)/(1 + I(t)/t^n) for every real t; and |a(t)| <= M t^(-beta) for every t > 0 with T t < S. Then a is continuous on the open interval (0, S/T), and Psi(rho) := exp(-integral_0^rho a(t) dt) * (1 + I(rho)/rho^n) is monotone nondecreasing on (0, S/T). (Integrals over E are Bochner integrals, integral_0^rho is the interval integral, t^(n+1) and t^n are natural powers, t^(-beta) is the real power, and division follows Lean's convention x/0 = 0.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (I a : ℝ → ℝ) (T S M β : ℝ), 0 < T → β < 1 → μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → IntegrableOn H (closedBall y S) μ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ t : ℝ, T ≤ t → φ t = 0) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → T * ρ < S → ∫ x, ((n : ℝ) * φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) + ‖x - y‖ / ρ * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ)) ∂μ ≤ -∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ) → (∀ t : ℝ, I t = ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ) → (∀ t : ℝ, a t = (∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ) / t ^ (n + 1) / (1 + I t / t ^ n)) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → T * t < S → |a t| ≤ M * t ^ (-β)) → ContinuousOn a (Ioo 0 (S / T)) ∧ MonotoneOn (fun ρ => Real.exp (-∫ t in (0)..ρ, a t) * (1 + I ρ / ρ ^ n)) (Ioo 0 (S / T))
